orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To construct a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon, we'll allocate our funds across different maturity buckets, spreading the risk. The laddered structure requires that no more than 30% of the portfolio matures in any single year. We'll create 5 maturity buckets, each 20% of the portfolio, from 1-5 years to ensure a stable cash flow. Since we're using investment-grade securities, we'll focus on high-quality bonds with minimum credit rating BBB+. We'll select bonds with staggered maturities to meet our target horizon. Our resulting portfolio will maintain a duration below 10 years, satisfying our constraints. The most conservative strategy will be adopted to ensure predictable cash flows and capital preservation within our limits.
